Register the definition through `tools/register.ts`, use the existing `ToolRuntime` error/observation path, and add a co-located test. 5. Measure token cost when tool descriptions or schemas materially change: `pnpm run measure:tokens`. Handlers receive inferred arguments. Keep manual argument casts, `any`, and `unknown` out of tool-handler code. Deterministic unit, mocked MCP, contract, stdio, package, and performance lanes use fake credentials and do not need a live key. Live Hevy lanes require a valid `HEVY_API_KEY`.
